title: Craftisle Resource Directory — 10,000+ Free Developer Resources
description: Explore Craftisle's curated resource directory with 10,000+ free tools, APIs, libraries, and self-hosted solutions. Organized across 40+ categories. The ultimate developer resource hub.

body.raw:
The Craftisle Resource Directory is the most comprehensive curated collection of free developer resources on the web — **10,129 resources** across 40+ categories, sourced and verified from the community's best lists.

## What's in the Directory?

### Categories at a Glance

The directory organizes resources into 12 major domains, each with detailed subcategories:

| Domain | Resources | Highlights |
|--------|-----------|------------|
| **Development** | 2,000+ | APIs, IDEs, code editors, CI/CD, testing, monitoring |
| **Infrastructure** | 1,500+ | Cloud, containers, databases, networking, security |
| **Design** | 800+ | UI kits, icons, fonts, color tools, prototyping |
| **Content** | 1,200+ | CMS, static site generators, documentation, blogging |
| **Media** | 900+ | Image editing, video tools, audio, 3D modeling |
| **Data & Analytics** | 700+ | Databases, analytics, visualization, data processing |
| **Productivity** | 800+ | Note-taking, project management, automation, collaboration |
| **Developer Tools** | 1,000+ | Code formatting, diff tools, regex, encoding, debugging |
| **Security** | 500+ | Encryption, authentication, vulnerability scanning, pentesting |
| **AI & ML** | 600+ | LLMs, model hosting, vector databases, AI agents |
| **Finance & Crypto** | 400+ | Payment processing, crypto tools, trading, accounting |
| **Education** | 729+ | Courses, tutorials, documentation, reference materials |

### Data Sources

The directory aggregates and curates resources from four major open-source lists:

1. **FMHY (6,187 resources)** — The largest community-maintained collection of free resources
2. **Free-for.dev (57 categories)** — SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS offerings with free tiers
3. **Awesome Self-Hosted (83 categories)** — Self-hosted alternatives to popular SaaS products
4. **Public APIs (51 categories)** — Free APIs for development and testing

Each resource is verified for:
- Active maintenance and recent updates
- Genuinely free offering (not just a free trial)
- Community reputation and GitHub stars (where applicable)
- Quality of documentation and developer experience

## How to Use the Directory

### Browse by Domain

Start by selecting a domain that matches your needs. Each domain page shows:
- All subcategories with resource counts
- Top-rated and most popular resources
- Recently added and updated entries
- Quick filters for platform, pricing model, and license type

### Search with Filters

The advanced search supports:
- **Keyword search** — Find resources by name, description, or tags
- **Category filter** — Narrow by domain and subcategory
- **Source filter** — Filter by data source (FMHY, Free-for.dev, etc.)
- **Sort options** — By popularity, rating, or recency

### Resource Detail Pages

Each resource has a dedicated page with:
- **Full description** — What it does and why it's useful
- **Pricing details** — Free tier limits and paid plan info
- **Alternatives** — Similar resources for comparison
- **External links** — Direct links to the resource and its documentation
- **Community notes** — Tips and caveats from the community

## Why This Directory Matters

### For Developers
- **Save hours of Googling** — Find the right tool in seconds instead of reading forum threads
- **Discover alternatives** — When a popular tool goes paid, find free replacements
- **Stay updated** — New resources added regularly from community submissions

### For Startups
- **Reduce SaaS costs** — Find free-tier tools that replace expensive subscriptions
- **Choose the right stack** — Compare options across categories before committing
- **Self-host to save** — Discover self-hosted alternatives to SaaS products

### For Students
- **Free learning resources** — 729+ educational resources, all free
- **Build a portfolio** — Find free hosting, domains, and development tools
- **Experiment freely** — No credit card required for any listed resource

## Integration with Craftisle Tools

The directory complements Craftisle's built-in tools:

| If you're looking for | Check the directory for |
|----------------------|------------------------|
| Image editing alternatives | Media → Image Editing |
| PDF tool supplements | Content → PDF Tools |
| Development tool ecosystem | Developer Tools |
| AI-powered alternatives | AI & ML |
| Self-hosted versions | Infrastructure → Self-Hosted |

## Community Contributions

The directory is a living resource. You can:
- **Submit new resources** — Suggest additions via GitHub
- **Report issues** — Flag outdated or broken links
- **Write reviews** — Share your experience with listed resources
- **Suggest categories** — Propose new domains or subcategories

Start exploring at [craftisle.com/directory](/directory) — your one-stop hub for free developer resources.
